road_damage_detector.architecture: YOLOv8s (Ultralytics YOLOv8 small, C2f backbone/head, 11.14M parameters)

upstream_benchmark_metrics.dataset: RDD2022 Multi-Country Benchmark Test Set (Japan/India/Czech Republic)
upstream_benchmark_metrics.source: Maeda et al., Crowdsensing-based Road Damage Detection Challenge 2022

local_evaluation.evaluation_protocol: Functional verification on representative road conditions

results.clean_asphalt_specificity: Zero false positive detections on pristine road surface

road_damage_detector.known_limitations: Optimized for asphalt roadways; lower sensitivity on gravel or mud tracks. Rain-slicked pavement can cause specular reflection artifacts.

waste_detector.architecture: YOLO11s (Ultralytics YOLO11 small, yolo11s.yaml with C3k2 and C2PSA layers, 9.43M parameters)

upstream_benchmark_metrics.dataset: TACO (Trash Annotations in Context) validation split (120 epochs)

local_evaluation.critical_note: Local evaluation confirms 100% presence detection on litter items, but precision is limited to 27.3% due to high false positives on complex municipal pavement textures. Upstream mAP is NOT claimed as local accuracy.

waste_detector.known_limitations: Significant domain gap between TACO dataset (controlled macro-photos of litter) and Indian municipal surveillance (wide street scenes, rubble, aggregate piles). High false-positive rate on textured pavements; confidence threshold configured at 0.20.

street_flooding_detector.architecture: None (No Calibrated Ground-Level Object Detector Deployed)

upstream_benchmark_metrics.note: No credible open-source ground-level object detection model exists for municipal street waterlogging.

local_evaluation.protocol: Integrity test with test image data/test_samples/street_flooding.jpg

street_flooding_detector.known_limitations: Explicitly unsupported. Public vision models for flood detection are either SAR/satellite remote sensing or binary text classifiers. Surface water detection cannot establish municipal pipe rupture or subsurface sewer overflow. Handled via human supervisory review without fabricating synthetic detections.
